initialization: Uniform behavioral strategy; CFR zero regrets, fictitious play one uniform prior observation, double oracle one uniform seed strategy per player.
comparison: All main runs complete the same iteration budget, even after first reaching the full SPR target. Same game, payoff scale, repetitions, deterministic tie handling, and warm-up. CFR certifies its average with two extra best responses every check_every iterations; FP and DO certify their current output every iteration using their own oracle values. Iterations have different work; compare elapsed time and work counts as well. Subsidiary analyses use separately recorded stopping rules.
chance: Exact weighted enumeration; no sampling or training seed.
history_storage: Complete measured histories are stored in per-run gzip JSONL files: CFR every check_every iterations, FP and DO every iteration. Main JSON retains exact regular history_output_every checkpoints, first target, requested summary checkpoints, and final observation. History archival is outside solver timing.
